text:
kai: spotting a weird split in invoice preview: same req_id showing up twice with different route_tags (standard vs priority).
neha: double emits? any recent router changes?
kai: router is unchanged but converter v4.2.0 was deployed 02:10 with the new header-rename: X-Route -> X-Route-Tag. proxy sends X-Route still. converter reads X-Route-Tag only. some requests end up with empty route_tag then a later enrichment step guesses 'priority' for certain tenants.
diego: that explains duplicates: initial event without tag created default_sku line, enrichment later emits a second event with priority tag creating another sku line. Aggregator sums both.
metering-bot: alert: duplicate-route_emits 96 events in 15m for service=converter
neha: quick fix: patch converter to fall back to X-Route if X-Route-Tag missing. low-risk single-line change.
kai: I'll open PR and roll to canary 2% first. also add a metric meter.kv.route_tag_fallback_count so we can track misses.
diego: for already-processed window (02:05..02:15) we should dedupe at aggregate level: compute per-req_id grouped token sum and collapse to single route_tag by precedence (enriched tag > default). Then regenerate preview. No ledger changes.
neha: good plan. add an audit column to preview to show `was_collapsed` so finance can see which lines were adjusted.
console-bot: ticket created: METR-4022 converter-route-header-fallback + dashboard card request
kai: will also add an integration test to assert header fallthrough. canary rolling now.
metering-bot: canary deploy success: converter v4.2.1-canary(2%)
diego: once backfill computed, run preview diff tool for a sample of 8 tenants and post diffs here. if anything >0.2% escalate to billing.
kai: on it, will post results in ~40m.
